recent: Swift Energy 近期获得总额 RM59.07 million 的采购订单，包括其首个 EPCC 项目。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度营收和净利均同比大幅增长。此外，公司近期有首席财务官变动及地址变更等企业事务。
notable: 获得总额 RM59.07 million 的采购订单，包括首个 EPCC 项目。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度净利同比增长 203.9%。
首席财务官 Foo Tze Xing 及 Ting Yi En 发生变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 23.715 million，同比增长 94.4%，环比增长 6.8%；净利为 MYR 5.243 million，同比增长 203.9%，环比增长 76.7%；净利率为 22.1%，高于上一季度的 13.4%。

recent_en: Swift Energy recently secured purchase orders totaling RM59.07 million, including its first EPCC project. The company's revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 both grew significantly year-on-year. In addition, there were changes in principal officer and registered address.
notable_en: Secured purchase orders totaling RM59.07 million, including first EPCC project.
Net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 grew 203.9% year-on-year.
Changes in principal officers Foo Tze Xing and Ting Yi En.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 23.715 million, up 94.4% year-on-year and 6.8% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 5.243 million, up 203.9% year-on-year and 76.7% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 22.1%, higher than 13.4% in the previous quarter.
